message.jaymoskingdoms.hedge_witch.0: The hedge witch flicks bog-water at you: "Quick feet. Go on, git."
message.jaymoskingdoms.hedge_witch.1: The hedge witch blows marsh-glow in your eyes: "Now ya see in da dark. Don't tell nobody."
message.jaymoskingdoms.hedge_witch.2: The hedge witch ties a reed round your wrist: "Lucky. For a bit."
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_home.moved: %s takes the shiny and nods. It'll sleep here now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_home.far: Too far from the village. It won't go that far.
